title: Ethics at the Heart of the Practice
subtitle: Dr. Mourad & Dr. Manal are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor!

Dr. Mourad has just opened his practice. Passionate, he wants to do things right. But one question haunts him: what are the ethical rules to follow?

Fortunately, Dr. Manal, an experienced dentist, is there to guide him.

Between professional secrecy, prohibited advertising, fees, collusion, and relationships between colleagues... the Code of Ethics is a true guide to ethical practice.

One infraction, and the practice's reputation is at stake.

Ethics, patient trust, and the practitioner's peace of mind rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Foundations of Ethics - Dr. Mourad has just opened his practice. He discovers the fundamental principles of the Code of Ethics with the help of Dr. Manal.
chapters.debutant2: Professional Relationships - Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal explore the rules of the profession: partnerships, replacements, relationships between colleagues.
chapters.intermediaire1: Expertise and Control - Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal address the aspects of expertise and dental control, sensitive areas of practice.
chapters.intermediaire2: Practical Cases - Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal analyze concrete cases of ethical violations. Each situation is a lesson in ethics.
chapters.expert1: Everyday Ethics - Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal become references in ethics. They train young dentists in responsible practice.
chapters.expert2: Excellence and Transmission - After years of practice, Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal pass on their ethical legacy to the new generation.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal have laid the foundations of ethical practice. But the road is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: The rules of the profession are mastered. Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal are ready for complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Expertise and control are integrated. Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal are gaining confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Practical cases are analyzed with rigor. Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal are ethics experts.
chapterEndings.expert1: Ethics has become second nature. Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Mourad and Dr. Manal have accomplished their mission. Ethics is the soul of the dental profession.
